scenarios.when: the active host cannot be identified as Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or Claude Desktop
scenarios.then: ask the user which supported host they use and do not modify files

scenarios.when: no local terminal, PowerShell, exec, or shell execution is available
scenarios.then: state that automatic local upgrade cannot run and provide the next official copyable command for the identified host; do not claim success

scenarios.when: the freshly cloned official main branch fails npm run check
scenarios.then: report the validation failure and stop before changing installed Skills

scenarios.when: a target directory with an official Skill name is missing the matching managed Skill markers
scenarios.then: report the exact conflict and stop before changing any target directory; do not overwrite, delete, rename, or merge it

scenarios.when: a supported CLI host has no conflicting target directories
scenarios.then: run the official sync command once, report every installed or upgraded Skill, and tell the user to start a new host conversation

scenarios.when: the active host is Claude Desktop
scenarios.then: build the current ZIP bundles and report their paths; instruct the user to upload and enable them in Claude Desktop, without reading configuration or claiming the UI update is complete
